description: Evaluate an expression in a running game, while it runs - no breakpoint needed. Uses Godot's Expression: calls, operators, member access and constructors, no statements or assignment. Names available: the base node's members (default the current scene), autoloads, engine singletons such as Input, and class_name globals. Calls run for real and may change the game. Returns: the value, or the engine's error text.

node.description: Base node path for member lookups (default: current scene)

session_id.description: Session from runtime_run. Required only when several games run.

name: runtime_eval
